// Known divergences between our dlang demangler and c++filt --format=dlang.
// Format: one mangled symbol per line.
// Blank lines and lines starting with // are ignored.
//
// Categories of divergence:
//
// 1. Function attributes (pure, nothrow, ref, @property, @trusted, @safe,
//    @nogc, return, scope, @live): our demangler surfaces these in the output,
//    c++filt --format=dlang strips them silently.
//
// 2. Linkage specifiers (Y = extern(C), Yc = extern(C++)): c++filt does not
//    demangle Y-linkage symbols — it returns the mangled form unchanged.
//    We decode them correctly.
//
// 3. Non-function type suffixes: symbols whose body is a bare type rather
//    than a function prototype (e.g. _D1a1bi, _D4test3fooAa).
//    Our output includes "[type: <tail>]"; c++filt outputs only the dotted name.
//
// 4. Variadic terminators: X (C variadic) / Y (typesafe variadic).
//    We encode as "[variadic]" / "[typesafe-variadic]" in the param list;
//    c++filt uses "..." / ", ..." appended to the last parameter.

// --- Function attributes ---
_D8demangle4testFNaZv
_D8demangle4testFNbZv
_D8demangle4testFNcZv
_D8demangle4testFNdZv
_D8demangle4testFNeZv
_D8demangle4testFNfZv
_D8demangle4testFNiZv
_D8demangle4testFNjZv
_D8demangle4testFNlZv
_D8demangle4testFNmZv
_D8demangle4testFNaNbZv
_D8demangle4testFNaNbNiNfZv

// --- Linkage (c++filt returns mangled symbol unchanged) ---
_D8demangle4testFYaZv
_D8demangle4testFYcZv

// --- Non-function type suffix ---
_D1a1bi
_D4test3fooAa
_D3std5ascii9uppercaseyAa

// --- Variadic terminators ---
_D8demangle4testFaXv
_D8demangle4testFaYv
_D8demangle4testFaaYv
